about: What is the engine's own about its functions (ADR-0047, SH-7): dependencies, refusals on entry, and XLOOKUP's regular expressions. What each function answers is in ExcelCases. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' FunctionTests; the declared list stays there until the calls cases read it.
